about: Every key trade_create.py reads from the data file of a quotation, order confirmation, delivery note, pro forma invoice or purchase order. The builder stops on a key that is not here, and on a value of another shape (skills/_shared/spec_guard.py). A fact with no field of its own goes in notes (lines under the totals), or, for a company's own particulars, in seller.further or buyer.further (the sender's print in the footer with its register details).

hints.contact: a contact person goes in "references" as {"label": "Contact", "value": "name, phone, e-mail"} with the label in the document's language; it prints in the information block
hints.seller.contact: a contact person goes in "references" as {"label": "Contact", "value": "name, phone, e-mail"} with the label in the document's language; it prints in the information block
hints.buyer.contact: a contact person goes in "references" as {"label": "Contact", "value": "name, phone, e-mail"} with the label in the document's language; it prints in the information block
hints.raised_by: who raised the order goes in "references" as {"label": "Raised by", "value": "name, role, phone, e-mail"} with the label in the document's language
hints.terms: terms go in "payment_terms" (one line), "delivery_terms" (an Incoterms rule and place) or "notes" (a list of lines under the totals)
hints.valid_until: a date with its label goes in "dates" as {"label": "Valid until", "value": "2026-11-14"}
hints.delivery_date: a date with its label goes in "dates" as {"label": "Delivery date", "value": "2026-11-02"}; a purchase order's own is "requested_delivery_date"
hints.lines.name: a line's text is "description"
hints.lines.price: a line's price is "unit_price", a number
hints.lines.note: a line has no note of its own: put it in the line's "description" or in the top-level "notes"
hints.deliver_to.attention: the delivery address prints as name, street, postcode, city and country: write the person or the opening hours in "notes"
hints.unknown: what the person's files do not give, printed as nothing and named in the reply: "number" (a document not numbered yet) and "bank"; a party's own particulars go in that party's "unknown"
